svg.text: CREAMIFY BROASTED CHICKEN - Variant C Bold Minimal with rooster-comb handle - PRODUCTION TEMPLATE v1

CONCEPT - DIMENSIONS/DIELINE TO BE CONFIRMED. Sizes are ASSUMED (derived from the proportions of the supplied flat, scaled to 250 mm front width). Replace with the manufacturer's approved dieline before print.
Magenta = cut | Blue dashed = fold | Cyan dashed = bleed (3 mm, assumed) | Green dotted = safe zone (6 mm, assumed) | Grey = glue, no print. Colours are RGB references; convert/match with printer.
